## Projects

### Educational Platform
A complete educational platform for the subject of chemistry. Features barcode-based attendance verification at classroom entry, an automated parent notification system for attendance confirmation, real-time internal chat, secure video and file upload management, and advanced content access control with time-based video restriction. Designed to enhance student engagement, streamline classroom management, and improve communication between instructors, students, and parents through scalable, high-performance system architecture.

### Commerce Platform
Smart commerce, inventory and QR tracking platform. Built a large-scale commerce platform with inventory management, warehouse operations, QR tracking, and analytics dashboards using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, and GraphQL.
